svg.title: Startup ability post-attachment replay
svg.desc: Before, initial icons were applied and then cleared by a second PreConstruct during viewport attachment, so they returned only after skill activation. After, initial ability information is replayed after attachment and restores all four icon brushes.
svg.text: Startup icons must replay after viewport attachment
Observed symptom: icons are empty at login, then appear when any skill produces a later UI update
BEFORE
Tags ready + controller listeners bound
Initial replay correctly applies four icon brushes
AddToViewport runs PreConstruct again
WBP_SpellGlobe calls ClearGlobe after the replay
First skill activation sends a later update
Icons finally become visible, masking the startup ordering bug
AFTER
TakeWidget establishes tags
Controller assignment binds all spell-globe listeners
AddToViewport completes final PreConstruct
Any lifecycle clear happens before ability publication
BroadcastInitialValues restores all four brushes
Icons are visible immediately; no activation is required
REGRESSION GUARD
Real WBP overlay + Blueprint controller
Final PreConstruct clear -> four-slot replay -> four matching icon resources
Validation
Focused UI pass; 9/9 ability suite; DebugGame build; Development Live Coding pass
Final order: CreateWidget -> TakeWidget -> SetWidgetController -> AddToViewport -> BroadcastInitialValues
